title: Senate approves proposed OVP 2027 budget in 1 minute
summary: The Senate on Thursday afternoon swiftly approved the proposed P785.2 million budget of the Office of the Vice President (OVP) for fiscal year 2027.

blocks.text: The Senate on Thursday afternoon swiftly approved the proposed P785.2 million budget of the Office of the Vice President (OVP) for fiscal year 2027.
Duterte was physically present in the Senate session hall amid the budget deliberations.
Senate Majority Leader Juan Miguel Zubiri quickly moved to extend the traditional courtesy to the OVP, with no senator asking questions.
This was approved by Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian. —AOL, GMA News
